parsed.post: Discarding the last run (1.0448) as it was worse than my best (1.0357). The LR increase to 0.07 seems to have caused instability. Reverting to depth 8 and LR 0.06. Next, I'll try adding a small amount of warmup (0.01) to see if it stabilizes the larger model without increasing BPB.
parsed.description: Adding a small warmup ratio (0.01) to the depth 8, LR 0.06 configuration to improve training stability.
